search_nutrition_info: search USDA FoodData Central for nutrition information given a food query string
search_nutrition_max_results: search USDA FoodData Central for nutrition info with a custom maximum number of results
display_food_nutrition: display formatted nutrition details including calories, protein, fat, carbs, fiber, and sugar for a food item
search_nutrition_stdin: search nutrition info for multiple foods provided via stdin pipe
run_nutrition_cli: run the nutrition search CLI with one or more food query arguments
